research_findings: Investigated a `localStorage` JSON parsing bug in `ultimate-sd/src/lib/session-storage.ts` where a single corrupted item could break the `getAllSessions` iteration because `try/catch` wrapped the entire loop.

Identified that fixing the bug by wrapping `JSON.parse` individually meant that removing corrupted items required carefully decrementing the loop index (`i--`), but a much cleaner and safer approach is to iterate backwards.
Identified React strict mode violation in AdaptiveCoachDemo.tsx reading from useRef during render.
features_improved: Refactored `getAllSessions` in `ultimate-sd/src/lib/session-storage.ts` to iterate backwards over `localStorage` (`for (let i = localStorage.length - 1; i >= 0; i--)`). This natively prevents index skipping when removing items without manual iterator adjustments.
Fixed strict mode violation by correctly reading state using useState.
next_steps_for_next_run: Implement a session dashboard to allow users to view all of their saved offline sessions, as noted in the SESSION_PERSISTENCE.md future enhancements section.
